generation.scope: Smooth plane cubic point graphs with disjoint finite residual are exactly all central PBW homogenizations of the three-dimensional smooth elliptic Sklyanin algebras with translation outside E[3]. This holds starting just with finite Frobenius and point fibers: consecutive pure relations rule out deficient transverse matrices, stability of the plane evaluation bundles gives cubic injectivity, and the ordinary central presentation follows. The residual is the length-eight affine critical scheme of an explicit cubic. All classes have bare period one.

open_mathematics: Classify nonplanar twisted cubic windows using binary divisibility of the cyclic tensor and the six-point residual. Other remaining branches include lower degrees, singular curves and high-rank finite point schemes.
